To resolve them, a support agent may need to enter the Subscriber's workspace and see their data. De cada acceso se guardan el agente, la: For each access we store the agent, the date and time of entry and exit, the stated reason, the IP address and whether the access was authorised or was an emergency. Cuando la incidencia impide esperar una: When the incident makes waiting for prior authorisation impossible —a lockout that leaves the Subscriber unable to operate, for instance— the agent may sign in by stating the reason. That access is flagged as unauthorised and the account owner receives a notice. It is not a silent permission: it is an access that is declared and that shows.
